name: Navajo Live
notes: not_found. Permanently closed. Business at 8515 Navajo Road, San Diego CA 92119 closed in 2025 and has been replaced by a bar called McGuffies (per web search of San Diego Reader / Yelp / local listings). It was a bar/nightclub with live entertainment (karaoke, comedy, live music), not primarily a food restaurant, and no priced food menu could be found even in archived listings. navajolive.com is a hijacked domain now serving Royal Reels Casino gambling content (confirmed via curl - page has zero relation to the restaurant). Marking not_found per playbook rule: permanently closed business, successor's menu (McGuffies) must not be borrowed for this record.

name: Submarine Crab
notes: Restaurant's own site (submarinecrabsd.com) is a React SPA using ChowNow's direct.chownow.com ordering widget, which is on the playbook's genuinely-needs-a-browser list; no server-rendered prices found there and no readable ChowNow API endpoint located via JS bundle grep, so it was handed back for that piece rather than guessed at. Used DoorDash marketplace server-side JSON-LD Menu schema instead (tier 3). 11 sections, 64 raw items; 'Most Ordered' (12 items) was a full duplicate subset of the categorized sections (0 unique items), dropped entirely; Party Trays (6 items) dropped as an adjunct per playbook. 58 final dishes across Seafood Boil by the pound, Seafood Boil Combos, Appetizers, Soups, Grilled Seafood, Entrees, Desserts, Extras, Drinks - matches the restaurant's own description as a Louisiana/Texas-style crawfish and seafood boil eatery. Markup test against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.17/1.2/1.25/1.3 found no consistent divisor (max 14% landing round, well within the 17-31% noise band), so treated as clean, undiscounted first-party pricing rather than delivery markup. Cross-checked against PriceListo (independent tier-5 aggregator): Shrimp head-on 1lb $23.50 vs $24.50 here, Fried Shrimp $18.25 vs $18.50, Combo 1 $67.50 vs $68.50 - consistently ~$0.50-1.00 higher on DoorDash, which reads as PriceListo being a slightly stale snapshot rather than a markup pattern (no consistent ratio across items).

name: The Art of Espresso
blocked: Small on-campus coffee cart (UCSD Mandeville Center). Own site (artofespresso.com) is a static single-page GoDaddy Website Builder page with no menu content, no prices, no ordering link. No DoorDash/UberEats/Postmates/Grubhub listing found via web search. joe.coffee has a shop profile (shopId 05a6798b-...) but orderingUrl is null and no menu/price data is exposed anywhere on that page or its known API paths (api.joe.coffee does not resolve; joe.coffee/api/shops/.../menu 404s). Yelp business page (yelp.com/biz/the-art-of-espresso-san-diego) 403s a bare curl and returns a CAPTCHA wall even via r.jina.ai - this is the most likely place to find a dated menu photo, but needs a real browser to get past the CAPTCHA. zmenu.com 403s; the-art-of-espresso.wa-cafe.com times out; artofespresso.gotoeat.net is a barred directory farm domain and was not used. Instagram profile (artofespressoucsd) has no menu or pricing content. Needs a browser to clear the Yelp CAPTCHA and check its photo gallery for a dated menu/board photo.
notes: Not marked not_found because Yelp photos are unverified, not exhausted - this is a browser limitation, not confirmation the business publishes no prices.

name: Pho Tam
notes: No website listed in the work list; found via web search as 'Pho Tam & Grill' at 1771 North 2nd Street, El Cajon - address matches the work list exactly, same business (Vietnamese pho restaurant), used the exact work-list name 'Pho Tam' in this record. DoorDash marketplace server-side JSON-LD Menu (tier 3). 9 sections, 'Most Ordered' (12 items) was almost fully a duplicate of the categorized sections - only 1 unique item (Thai Milk Tea) kept from it, rest dropped. 80 final dishes across Sandwiches Banh Mi, Pho (19 items - full pho section, matches this being a pho house), Rice Dishes, Fried Rice, Rice Plates, Appetizers, Vegetarian Dishes, and Vermicelli Noodles. Markup test: dividing by 1.25 put 32.5% of prices on an exact-dollar result, which looked suspicious at first, but the restaurant prices everything on a quarter-dollar grid ($17.50/$17.75/$18.00/$18.25/$18.50/$18.75/$19.25 etc across nearly every entree) - dividing a quarter-dollar grid by 1.25 lands on a $0.20 grid by simple arithmetic, and only the subset of prices that are also multiples of $1.25 (e.g. $7.50, $10.00, $12.50, $15.00) hit an exact dollar value coincidentally. No other factor (1.04/1.1/1.15/1.17/1.2/1.3) showed a comparable pattern, so treated this as an artifact of quarter-dollar POS pricing rather than a real delivery markup.

name: heartwork coffee
blocked: Two-domain setup, neither serves prices to a plain fetch. (1) heartworkcoffeebar.com is a Shopify storefront but /products.json returns only 6 retail whole-bean coffee bags (Ethiopia, Mexico Dragon, Sidamo, Placebo Decaf, Embodiment Espresso, The Good Stuff) - what the site SELLS ONLINE, not the cafe drink/food menu. (2) The real ordering site, heartworkcoffee.site, is Square Online built on the Weebly platform (window.APP_ORIGIN='https://square.online', window.APP_URL='https://www.weebly.com') - a client-side rendered commerce app. window.__BOOTSTRAP_STATE__ carries category names (Online Menu, Heartwork Coffee, Holiday Drinks x2, SPRING MENU, Items - category IDs e.g. YIBXX2YBXHCRQRIIFG635KIB for 'Online Menu') and the merchant/site IDs (squareMerchantId 6VKP3NQY4YA71, classicSiteID/catalogSiteId 333850507423487343), but the category page's own bootstrap payload shows 'pagination':{'products':[]} - the item list and all prices are fetched by client-side JS after mount, matching the playbook's Square Online/*.square.site needs-a-browser case even though this is on a custom domain. Only one priced source was reachable: allmenus.com's listing (which is itself Grubhub-owned/branded 'Menu ... provided by Allmenus.com... GrubHub, Inc.') showing 29 items (Espresso $2.50, Americano S/M/L $2.75-3.50, Latte S/L $4.50/$5.25, Cold Brew $3.75, etc) - real coffee-shop price levels, plausible, but per playbook a single tier-5 source cannot stand alone and this is Grubhub-family data (one owner), not two independent agreeing sources. menupix.com 403s / CAPTCHA-gates even via r.jina.ai; restaurantji.com has reviews but no prices; joe.coffee profile has no ordering/pricing. No DoorDash or Uber Eats listing exists per web search ('mobile ordering isn't available at Heartwork Coffee yet'). Needs a browser to load heartworkcoffee.site/shop/online-menu/YIBXX2YBXHCRQRIIFG635KIB and read the client-fetched product list, or a second independent tier-5 source to corroborate the allmenus figures.
notes: Not not_found - a real priced menu almost certainly exists (Grubhub/allmenus data looks legitimate), just not independently confirmed or server-side reachable.

name: Estrada's Mexican Food
notes: Work-list website (estradasmexicanfoodgo.site) does not resolve (DNS failure, dead domain). There are at least 3 separate Estrada's Mexican Food locations in Santee (8528 Magnolia Ave #107, 9292 Carlton Hills Blvd, 9630 Carlton Hills Blvd) - per playbook, one branch's menu must not be filed under another branch's id, so branch-matching mattered here. A DoorDash listing exists (doordash.com/store/estradas-mexican-food-santee-25322787/) but 403'd a plain curl and a web-search snippet associated delivery/takeout at that DoorDash listing with the 9292 Carlton Hills Blvd address specifically, not Magnolia Ave, so it was not used to avoid a branch mismatch. Used SinglePlatform instead (tier 4): its address (8528 N Magnolia Ave, Santee, CA 92071) matches the work list exactly. 25 priced items across Burritos, Combinations Plates, Tacos, Tostadas, Quesadillas and Dessert - a plausible full section list for a small counter-service taco shop; Flan (also under Dessert) had no price in the source and was dropped rather than guessed. Per playbook, SinglePlatform data should be treated as stale until proven current - alternatives were exhausted: estradasmexicanfoodgo.twupro.com and estradassantee.mybistro.online are both templated/AI-generated directory-farm pages with no real per-item prices (generic 'Best Seller'/'Popular' placeholder cards, one literally saying 'Our menu is under update'), zmenu.com 403'd, and Yelp CAPTCHA-gated even via r.jina.ai so no dated menu photo could be checked. Prices ($1.25-$5.49) are low but not implausible for a small value taco counter; could not independently confirm currency.
